name: exists_lt_lowerSemicontinuous_lintegral_ge_of_aemeasurable

name: exists_lt_lowerSemicontinuous_integral_gt_nnreal
statement: α → ℝ≥0) (fint : Integrable (fun x => (f x : ℝ)) μ) {ε : ℝ} (εpos : 0 < ε) : ∃ g : α → ℝ≥0∞, (∀ x, (f x : ℝ≥0∞) < g x) ∧ LowerSemicontinuous g ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x < ⊤) ∧ Integrable (fun x => (g x).toReal) μ ∧ (∫ x, (g x).toReal ∂μ) < (∫ x, ↑(f x) ∂μ) + ε

name: exists_lt_lowerSemicontinuous_integral_lt
